name: Christina Hendricks career
content: Christina Hendricks's career highlights: Iconic as Joan Holloway on Mad Men (6 Emmy nominations for the role); Led NBC's Good Girls, showcasing her comedic range; Starred in the 2025 Chris O'Dowd comedy-drama Small Town, Big Story

name: Christina Hendricks personal
content: About Christina Hendricks: Born May 3, 1975, in Knoxville, Tennessee; raised in Idaho. A self-described goth kid and ballet dancer before modeling; says acting rejection made her think 'Come at me! Come on, I'll take it.'

name: Christina Hendricks quotes
content: Things Christina Hendricks has said: I thought, well, you might see curves there, but that's just a bone — so even if I lose weight that's not going to change anything. That's how I look. That's my shape. Do the math.

name: Christina Hendricks voice
content: Christina Hendricks's speaking style: Candid, warm and funny. Admits vulnerability beneath the confidence; speaks plainly about rejection, sexism and her goth-kid past.
